# PureLand

> PureLand is a research-program prototype and forkable toolbox for asking whether an information practice can increase a person's control over their attention without also increasing their exposure or extractability. This is version 0.1. Its instruments are unvalidated and no independent field trial has been accepted. Nothing in this repository certifies that a system is open or safe. [CURRENT-EVIDENCE.md](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/CURRENT-EVIDENCE.md) holds the evidence record and caps every claim about what PureLand has shown.

Notes for a model reading this repository:

- [CURRENT-EVIDENCE.md](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/CURRENT-EVIDENCE.md): the ceiling on any claim about what PureLand has shown. Do not state or imply a stronger result.
- Schema conformance of a field-test record means the record carries the required fields and satisfies structural rules. It does not mean the method was completed or that any construct has been validated.
- The repository contains methods, templates, and public-safe records only. Participant recordings, transcripts, names, contact details, identifying data, consent and relationship records, confidential records, client records, and protected community knowledge must never enter it.
- A license here does not create permission for participant or third-party material. Recording, retention, named-reviewer access, publication, approval of each artifact version, research use, AI processing, and model training each require a separate decision.

## Research spine

- [Thesis](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/THESIS.md): the organizing argument and its limits.
- [Method](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/METHOD.md): a bounded inquiry into one information practice, from question to return, refusal, private result, or an explicit unmeasurable result.
- [Toolbox](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/TOOLBOX.md): the forkable instruments, templates, controls, and public-safe records. Its presence validates nothing.
- [Hypothesis](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/HYPOTHESIS.md): the primary testable claim and what would count against it.
- [Testing](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/TESTING.md): the testing program; every test begins with a result that would count against the tested hypothesis.
- [Current evidence](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/CURRENT-EVIDENCE.md): the observed record, counterexplanations, missing evidence, and the narrow current conclusion.
- [Research status](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/RESEARCH-STATUS.md): the limits ledger for the current version and the evidence required before the next gate can clear.
- [Field-trial ledger](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/FIELD-TRIALS.md): one maintainer-side, AI-assisted partial dry run with an inspectable report; no independent field trial has been accepted.

## Journey and instruments

- [Journey](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/JOURNEY.md): the one curated path through the toolbox: Ground, Observe, Map, Trace, Adapt, Return.
- [Practice frame](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/PRACTICE-FRAME.md): the observe station.
- [Openness scorecard](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/SCORECARD.md): the experimental map-station instrument; it keeps understandable, reachable, adaptable, and traceable evidence separate. No combined score, no certification.
- [Extraction check](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/EXTRACTION-CHECK.md): the trace station; use it after the scorecard, or before opening a system further.
- [AI system annex](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/AI-SYSTEM-ANNEX.md): use it at the map station when a practice includes a model, automated decision, generative interface, recommender, transcription service, or agent.
- [Facilitation protocol](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/PROTOCOL.md): use it when an inquiry records an encounter or draws on existing participant material.
- [Field-testing discipline](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/FIELD-TESTING.md): runs alongside the journey and tries to break the method; confirmation alone is weak evidence.

## Data

- [Data boundary](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/data/README.md): what the data directory may and may not contain, and how validation runs.
- [Field-test schema](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/data/field-test.schema.json): JSON Schema, Draft 2020-12; the required record for method version 0.1 and the structural gate on public field-test JSON.
- [Field-test record](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/data/field-tests/ft-001-alchemy.json): FT-001, the only current structured public-safe record; its test status is `partial-execution`.
- [Repository checker](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/scripts/check_repo.py): validates every record against the schema, then applies semantic rules to the conformant set.
- [Research lane](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/research/README.md): the index of reviewed, rights-cleared research records.

## Rights and governance

- [Rights and consent](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/RIGHTS-AND-CONSENT.md): separates license, consent, authority, and publication decisions.
- [Governance](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/GOVERNANCE.md): sole maintainership; that concentration of power is a project risk, not a mature commons.
- [Contributing](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/CONTRIBUTING.md): PureLand needs documented disagreement more than applause.
- [Security](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/SECURITY.md): what must never appear in a public issue.
- [License](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/LICENSE.md): CC BY-SA 4.0 for original text, diagrams, and templates; MIT for repository code and configuration files.
- [Citation metadata](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/CITATION.cff): machine-readable title, author, repository, version, and both repository licenses.

## Optional

- [Brief](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/BRIEF.md): the shorter external overview.
- [Offering](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/OFFERING.md): the field pilot, the journey walked together as a small bounded inquiry.
- [Provenance](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/PROVENANCE.md): the sources that materially shape the kit.
- [Origin](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/ORIGIN.md): the maintainer's personal history with Zen practice; not yet written.
- [AI assistance](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/AI-ASSISTANCE.md): the record of AI assistance in producing the kit.
- [Changelog](https://risaac09.github.io/pureland-fork-kit/CHANGELOG.md): what changed per version.
